title: Godot 4.4 always creates a new `.csproj.old` file when opening an already converted project
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.4.stable.mono.official.4c311cbee
- Not reproducible in 4.3

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable.mono - Fedora Linux 41 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (RADV NAVI31) - AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads)

### Issue description

Whenever I open my C# project in Godot I get a new .csproj.old file generated. This should only happen the first time the project was converted to 4.4, but it keeps happening each time I reopen Godot Editor. I remember there being a similar bug in the past so it seems the bug is back. I'm opening this issue as I couldn't find any issues when searching for `.csproj.old`.

### Steps to reproduce

- Open Godot to a C# project (`godot --editor .`)
- After the editor loads check the project folder and see the new .csproj.old file that was generated

This is what the terminal output is for running that command:
